title: Quantum-cosmological corrections to inflationary spectra from Gaussian wave packets
summary: In the context of quantum cosmology, we study quantum entanglement in solutions of the Wheeler--DeWitt equation for a homogeneous inflaton--gravity system coupled to perturbations. The wave function describing the homogeneous degrees of freedom is entangled with the wave function describing the perturbations, and this may lead to potentially observable effects on the inflationary spectra.
